newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Utilicorp, Mercury to unite WEL Energy shares.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Utilicorp, Mercury to unite WEL Energy shares.

text.p: Utilicorp NZ and Mercury Energy will sell their shares in WEL Energy to the joint venture company both are forming, or to Power New Zealand, as part of their joint acquisition of Power New Zealand, Utilicorp NZ said on Tuesday.
WEL Energy supplies electricity to the Hamilton region, in New Zealand's North Island.
Utilicorp NZ (UNZ), a unit of Utilicorp United Inc, has 39.5 percent of WEL Energy. Mercury has about 2 percent of WEL.

Earlier, UNZ and Mercury, both unlisted New Zealand electricity suppliers, ended a long-running battle for control of Power New Zealand when they announced they would join forces. Power New Zealand is New Zealand's second largest electricity company.
